q4_normal_strength.finding: The modular importer does NOT ignore normal strength. That blocker (STOP_REPORT 12:35Z, repeated in USER_STOP_STATUS_REPORT) describes import_prepared.material_for (Staging/BankIntegration_2026-10-04/import_prepared.py lines 116-118), which wires the sampled normal RGB straight to MP_NORMAL. Modular materials use the adapter's own material_for (modular_native_adapter_v004.py lines 153-165, unchanged since v001). It decodes n=(2r-1, 1-2g, 2b-1) with one OpenGL-to-DirectX green flip, scales by (s, s, clamp(s,0,1)), adds (0, 0, 1-clamp(s,0,1)), normalizes and connects the result to MP_NORMAL. That equals Blender's normalize((nx*s, ny*s, 1+(nz-1)*clamp(s,0,1))).
